description: Two deterministic hosts (one application row, one platform row, one REPORTED_WITH edge each) in one account/region, driven through the production writer over an InstrumentedExecutor in a single WriteHostObservationBatch. HostNodeWriter fans out to exactly three kind dispatches (application nodes, platform nodes, REPORTED_WITH edges, node-then-edge) and the default batch size covers all rows, so the writer emits exactly three UNWIND write statements (eshu_dp_neo4j_batches_executed_total=3, statements_executed=3). Any increase — an N+1 write cycle, an extra batch split, or a new kind dispatch — trips the gate.
